doc: Sound kit for GameAssets.luau (forge/director.py). Every id must play in a Studio playtest: rbxasset://sounds/* ship with every Roblox client; each rbxassetid:// id was loaded (Sound.IsLoaded) in a Studio playtest on the date in 'checked'. Third-party audio can be blocked by audio privacy once a game is published under another owner: 'fallback' is the built-in sound to swap in. pitch = default PlaybackSpeed; keywords pick the kit sound for a director's sound description. 'music' is the looping area music of ReplicatedStorage/Kit/MusicPlayer.luau (forge/kit/modules, same ids): Roblox-licensed APM library tracks, each loaded on Client and Server in a Studio playtest (PreloadAsync Success, Sound.IsLoaded, time_length = Sound.TimeLength in seconds) on the date in 'checked'; mood groups them, keywords match an area to a mood.
